messages:
sara: Short RFC follow-up idea: introduce a 'semantic anchor' primitive in rollout metadata. owners can publish a semantic contract checksum (semantic_hash) that asserts behavioral invariants; minor build/quant changes that preserve the contract are anchored to that semantic_hash for a configurable TTL to reduce churn while preserving strict auditability.

dmitri: hmm. what lives in the contract? just a hash? how do we prove two variants preserve semantics vs just having similar perf?

yun: onboarding should produce a `contract_check_id` referencing a signed verification run (canonical probes + acceptance criteria). platform runs an independent quick-check and emits `anchor_score`. only variants with anchor_score >= threshold can join an anchor.

mike: audit/compliance: we must never hide variant hashes. every inference must record `variant_hash` + resolved `semantic_anchor_id` (if any). anchor is an ops abstraction; audit shows concrete artifact used.

kevin: routing: propose fields: `semantic_anchor_id` (opt), `anchor_ttl_days`, `anchor_mode` enum("preserve","observe"), `anchor_compatible_pools` list, `rollback_token` optional string. Resolver maps to member variants deterministically; tenant pins override anchors.

emily: UX: surface anchor formation with explainer: "This anchor groups compatible variants for X days. Tenants may opt-out." Add a one-click "migrate to anchor" CTA and show expected delta (latency/cost).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for variant v8-quant started on release/2026-06-15 :rocket:

dmitri: what about failures later? if a variant breaches the contract post-formation, we need a safe revocation/rollback path.

yun: add `anchor_revocation_ts`, `revocation_reason`, and an automated `rollback_token` that tenants and owners can use to pin back to a known-good variant. platform can also auto-split an anchor on revocation.

mike: telemetry: capture `anchor_stability_score` over time, `rollback_token_uses`, `post_anchor_regressions`, `migration_success_rate`, `latency_p95_delta`, `cost_delta_per_token`. retention: keep per-variant traces exportable for 365d for audits.

kevin: impl note: compute `semantic_anchor_id` deterministically (sha256(owner_id + semantic_hash + sorted variant_hashes at formation)) so replicas/backfills converge. store anchor manifest: member list + formed_ts + contract_check_id.

emily: tenant controls: `tenant_settings.anchor_opt_out: bool` default false but orgs can lock to true for regulated tenants. also support `tenant_exemptions` list so specific tenants can be excluded/included.

sara: security: contract_check must be owner-signed and include harness fingerprint. store checks and attestations immutably; UI shows attestation summary and link to full evidence bundle.

yun: autoscaler/pools: anchors mixing differing hardware pools should be explicitly allowed via `anchor_compatible_pools` and must include `pool_fallback_policy` enum("prefer","mirror","reject").

sara: next steps: i'll draft a small RFC + data-model PR with fields: semantic_anchor_id, semantic_hash, anchor_ttl_days, anchor_mode, contract_check_id, anchor_score, anchor_compatible_pools, pool_fallback_policy, rollback_token, anchor_revocation_ts, revocation_reason, tenant_settings.anchor_opt_out, tenant_exemptions. will add example logs and UI copy. posting draft later today.
